author_allowed: Eight exact original map packets and original review excerpts
Original donor context only if explicitly exported and pinned by coordinator
author_quarantined: All prior repaired child map geometry, PNGs and implementation diffs
Post-repair Feature Atlas states and astra-current.v1.json
Curator restricted directory and full issue199/200 discussions

roles.curator: selection and hidden reference custody; no geometry
roles.author: sole experimental geometry implementer; original-only
roles.reviewer: independent tests and evaluation; no geometry; reference-blind until output lock
roles.coordinator: integration and publication; no geometry authoring

unlock_rule: All eight dispositions, complete output hashes and experimental commit IDs frozen before any prior repaired reference is given to reviewer.
scope_limit: Prior reworker output is not verified human authorship.
